I saved the draft mail to Hollis and told Anselm in their DM. Nothing has been sent; it's only a draft.

- **Approval:** Anselm is the CFO, so his approval covers sharing this rate with Hollis. Hollis's address is on pemberline.com, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply.
- **Draft:** It goes to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it, and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June before passing the figure on.
- **Unchecked figure:** I couldn't confirm the $2,101. No Thornbury files show up on the share, so the draft uses the figure Anselm gave in his message. I told him that in my reply.

GBrain had nothing on Thornbury, but its search was running in a reduced mode, so that doesn't prove there are no notes.
